messages:
Asha (prod): Quick flagday check — owners for the Q3 infra milestone? what shipped vs slipped? TL;DR please.
Diego: Shipped: runtime v2 canary rolled to 10% traffic; embedding cache in staging. Slipped: dedicated autoscaler rollout (blocked on cloud quota).
Marta: CR ping for autoscaler PR #452 — needs one more review. @Jon can you take a look?
Jon: On it, ETA end of day. Saw a test flake in scale test, investigating.
Asha (prod): Who's owning the rollout runway for Dedicated capacity? Need an ETA for product plan.
Diego: I'm the tech lead for the rollout, but Priya (SRE) is co-owner for quota and infra changes.
Priya: Quota request still pending with cloud support (ticket 123456). Vendor quoted 48-72h. :frowning: I'll escalate.
Marta: If quota is delayed, fallback option: canary to fewer GPUs + tighter batch config. I can prototype a patch.
Diego: That sounds right — perf will drop but we keep p95/p99 SLOs. We should prepare a config toggle and a canary playbook.
Jon: I pushed a small config tweak to canary: `--batch-window-ms=8` and `--max-batch-tokens=1024` — appears stable in staging. PR link: https://git/repo/pulls/458
Asha (prod): Action items: (1) Jon finish PR review & merge, (2) Marta prepare fallback rollout doc + runbook, (3) Priya keep cloud ticket updated and escalate as needed. Owners: Jon / Marta / Priya. Target: EOD Wednesday. Everyone ok with that?
Priya: Agree. I'll update the ticket and ping vendor again.
Marta: Will draft the fallback doc and drop to #eng-runtime for review. Aim: PR for fallback config by tomorrow morning.
Diego: I'll queue a scale test re-run once quota is cleared OR after fallback patch merged.
CI Bot: Build passed — PR 458 CI green. :white_check_mark:
Asha (prod): Quick scoreboard recap: shipped = runtime v2 canary, embedding cache staging; slipped = dedicated autoscaler rollout; blockers = cloud quota. Next sync only if blocker persists. :thumbsup:
Jon: Tiny follow-up — we should add `autoscaler_enabled` to the rollout dashboard. Filing ticket INF-789.
Marta: Noted, tagging INF-789 on the doc draft so reviewers see linkage. cc @Diego
Diego: Thanks team — I'll keep monitoring and post updates in this thread.
Asha (prod): Thanks all for the quick responses. If anything slips, ping me directly or update the milestone doc.
